room_rent.note: VERIFY: wording sets room rent 'up to the Room Rent limit as specified in Policy Schedule'; base limit not stated in wording text

icu.note: VERIFY: ICU/ICCU per Policy Schedule; not stated in wording

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay on base; optional voluntary 10%/20% co-pay (Section D.15)

sub_limits.note: Length-of-stay options (5/10/unlimited days) can cap IPD; bariatric capped

maternity.note: Women Care Benefit (D.12) maternity is an optional cover; 48-month waiting; not inbuilt in base

cumulative_bonus.note: No inbuilt cumulative bonus; optional Booster Benefit (D.10) adds 50%/yr up to 200% of base SI

restoration.note: No inbuilt restoration; optional Unlimited Refill (D.5) 100% base SI, related+unrelated, from first claim

day_care.note: Covered if admitted >2 hrs; incl. angiography/dialysis/radio/chemo

organ_donor.note: VERIFY: no dedicated organ donor cover found in wording

ambulance.note: VERIFY: Emergency Road Ambulance up to limit specified in Policy Schedule; amount not stated in wording

consumables.note: Non-payable/List-I items waived only if optional Benefit D.8 opted; not inbuilt

global_cover.note: No overseas treatment cover found in wording

grace_period.note: 30 days (non-monthly modes); 15 days for monthly premium

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary excluded; cumulative bonus, restoration, maternity, consumables all OPTIONAL add-ons; standard IRDAI exclusions

optional_riders.display: Booster Benefit (bonus), Unlimited Refill, Women Care/Maternity, Assisted Reproduction, Non-payable items (D.8), Voluntary co-pay, Domestic Help indemnity
